_comment: Written by /bug-hunter. coverage.json is the index of where to hunt next; workflow/hunts/checked/ is the full record of what was examined. lastHunted null = never hunted, and never goes first. Imported from the Labstock workflow on 2026-08-13 with Camea's own areas; nothing has been hunted yet.

_runEntryShape.snapshot: <sha the hunt worktree was detached at>
_runEntryShape.note: one paragraph: what each round found, and what the next run should pick up

_lastResult: one of found | dry | skipped — a skipped area must never look like a clean one.

dataset-knowledge.note: HARD RULE 3, and the one the author has paid real cost to enforce. src/camea/ and web/src/ must know nothing about any particular dataset. Hunt this first.

storage.note: BEHAVIOUR R44. Everything a feature builds lands in <project>/outputs/; the user is never asked where anything goes. A finding here is almost always high.

engine.note: READ-ONLY. src/camea/engine/{t27,t33,quality,render}.py is byte-identical to archive/analysis/mosaic/ and under the 312/312 guard. The hunter reads it and its callers; it never edits, and it never runs the guard.

behaviour.note: docs/BEHAVIOUR.md's ~44 rulings against the code and against web/tests/e2e/. A ruling with no test is a real finding.

knowledge-base.note: utils/knowledge/ is gitignored, so findings here never travel with the repo — file them anyway; the pile is local and so is the fix.

ui.note: Needs the app running. See bug-hunter.md § the browser — the hunt worktree has no node_modules and no dataset.

ux.note: Needs the app running, and every finding is said-checked against workflow/said/ledger.md before it files.

workflow.note: workflow/ and .claude/ — imported 2026-08-13 and never yet swept. A first pass over it is cheap and will find broken links.
